description: box [0,0,0]–[40,30,10] minus a cylinder r 4 whose wall touches the face x = 40 from outside along a ruling: a tangent contact that removes no material, so the result is the plate with every id kept (8/12/6/6). Open CASCADE imprints the ruling on the touched face and reports 10/15/7/7 — a convention Arris does not follow, stated in counts_differ (plan m4-booleans step 11)

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE imprints the tangent ruling on the touched face and splits the two rim edges it meets; Arris keeps the face whole — a touch from outside removes no material and makes no edge
